#--------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. ALIGNMENT SETTINGS & PATHS
#--------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
WINDOW        <- 240       # Rolling window length (months)
HORIZONS      <- 1:12      # Direct forecasting horizons h = 1, ..., 12
N_LAGS        <- 4         # 4 lags of every predictor
N_VAL         <- 50        # Validation months (latest 50 with known outcomes)
RETUNE_EVERY  <- 12        # Re-validate once every 12 months (yearly)
SEED          <- 456857
```

# Target datasets (main: official; robustness: self)
```{r}
SAMPLES       <- c(official = "main_data_official.rds", self = "main_data_self.rds")
DATA_SAMPLE   <- "official" # Change to "self" or run loop for both samples
```


# Model grid settings
```{r}
RF_N_TREES    <- 500       # Default trees for RF and Bagging
XGB_ETA       <- 0.05      # Shrinkage / learning rate
XGB_DEPTHS    <- c(2, 4)   # Tree max_depth grid
XGB_NMAX      <- 600      # Max boosting rounds
XGB_KS        <- seq(10, XGB_NMAX, by = 10) # Boosting rounds evaluation grid

N_PC          <- 4         # 4 PCs added to predictor set (following Medeiros / Ridge)

# System Cores allocation
N_CORES       <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") 1 else max(1, detectCores() - 1)
NTHREAD       <- if (N_CORES > 1) 1 else 4

# Output directory for GitHub forecast combination
FC_DIR        <- here("results", "forecasts")
dir.create(FC_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

#--------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. DATA PREPARATION 
#--------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
fill_forward <- function(x) {
  for (i in seq_along(x)[-1]) if (is.na(x[i])) x[i] <- x[i - 1]
  x
}

load_sample_data <- function(file, us_vars = NULL) {
  df <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", file))
  df <- df[order(df$date), ]
  df <- df[!is.na(df$inflation_mom), ] # First month has no inflation yet
  
  can    <- grep("^CAN_", names(df), value = TRUE)
  us_all <- grep("^US_",  names(df), value = TRUE)
  us     <- if (identical(us_vars, "all")) us_all else intersect(us_vars, us_all)
  
  # Design matrix Y: Column 1 = dependent variable (inflation_mom)
  Y     <- cbind(inflation = df$inflation_mom, as.matrix(df[, c(can, us)]))
  dates <- df$date
  
  # Forward-fill any remaining gap in predictors
  Y[, -1] <- apply(Y[, -1, drop = FALSE], 2, fill_forward)
  bad <- colSums(is.na(Y)) > 0
  if (any(bad)) Y <- Y[, !bad, drop = FALSE]
  
  stopifnot(nrow(Y) > WINDOW + 1)
  nprev <- nrow(Y) - WINDOW
  
  list(Y = Y, dates = dates, nprev = nprev)
}
```

#--------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. HELPER FUNCTIONS & DESIGN MATRIX CREATION
#--------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
train_rows <- function(t, h) max(1, t - WINDOW):(t - h)

# Standardized design matrix with 4 lags and 4 principal components
design_ml <- function(Ysub, h, n_pc = N_PC) {
  ok <- apply(Ysub, 2, sd) > 0
  Ysub_clean <- Ysub[, ok, drop = FALSE]
  
  if (n_pc > 0) {
    pc_feats <- prcomp(Ysub_clean, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE, rank. = n_pc)$x
    Ysub_aug <- cbind(Ysub_clean, pc_feats)
  } else {
    Ysub_aug <- Ysub_clean
  }
  
  aux <- embed(Ysub_aug, N_LAGS + h)
  y   <- aux[, 1]
  X   <- aux[, -(1:(ncol(Ysub_aug) * h)), drop = FALSE]
  colnames(X) <- paste0("V", 1:ncol(X))
  
  x_out <- tail(aux, 1)[1:ncol(X)]
  x_out <- matrix(x_out, nrow = 1, dimnames = list(NULL, colnames(X)))
  
  list(y = y, X = X, x_out = x_out)
}
```

#--------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. MODEL FITTERS & CANDIDATE EVALUATION
#--------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
# ---- Random Forest (mtry = floor(P/3)) ----
rf_candidates <- function(Ysub, h) {
  d <- design_ml(Ysub, h, n_pc = N_PC)
  model <- randomForest(d$X, d$y, ntree = RF_N_TREES, importance = TRUE)
  pred  <- as.numeric(predict(model, d$x_out))
  list(pred = pred, importance = importance(model))
}

# ---- Bagging (mtry = P) ----
bag_candidates <- function(Ysub, h) {
  d <- design_ml(Ysub, h, n_pc = N_PC)
  model <- randomForest(d$X, d$y, mtry = ncol(d$X), ntree = RF_N_TREES, importance = TRUE)
  pred  <- as.numeric(predict(model, d$x_out))
  list(pred = pred, importance = importance(model))
}

# ---- XGBoost Candidates (Grid across depths and rounds) ----
xgb_candidates <- function(Ysub, h) {
  d <- design_ml(Ysub, h, n_pc = N_PC)
  n <- nrow(d$X)
  
  # Validation split for tuning rounds/depth inside candidate window
  tr  <- 1:(n - N_VAL - h)
  va  <- (n - N_VAL + 1):n
  dva <- xgb.DMatrix(d$X[va, , drop = FALSE])
  
  preds_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = 1, ncol = length(XGB_DEPTHS) * length(XGB_KS))
  col_idx <- 1
  
  make_params <- function(depth) list(
    objective = "reg:squarederror", eta = XGB_ETA, max_depth = depth,
    subsample = 0.5, colsample_bytree = 0.5, nthread = NTHREAD
  )
  
  for (depth in XGB_DEPTHS) {
    m <- xgb.train(make_params(depth), xgb.DMatrix(d$X, label = d$y), nrounds = XGB_NMAX)
    for (k in XGB_KS) {
      preds_matrix[1, col_idx] <- predict(m, xgb.DMatrix(d$x_out), iterationrange = c(1, k))
      col_idx <- col_idx + 1
    }
  }
  
  list(pred = as.numeric(preds_matrix))
}
```

#--------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. RECURSIVE VALIDATION & RUNNER
#--------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
candidate_errors_ml <- function(model, s, h) {
  months <- (WINDOW + 1 - h - N_VAL + 1):(WINDOW + s$nprev)
  
  res <- lapply(months, function(m) {
    Ysub <- s$Y[train_rows(m, h), , drop = FALSE]
    if (model == "rf") {
      rf_candidates(Ysub, h)
    } else if (model == "bag") {
      bag_candidates(Ysub, h)
    } else if (model == "xgb") {
      xgb_candidates(Ysub, h)
    }
  })
  
  pred <- do.call(rbind, lapply(res, `[[`, "pred")) # months x candidates
  list(months = months, pred = pred, err = (s$Y[months, 1] - pred)^2)
}

choose_candidate_ml <- function(ce, t, h) {
  val <- match((t - h - N_VAL + 1):(t - h), ce$months)
  mse <- colMeans(ce$err[val, , drop = FALSE])
  pos <- which.min(mse)
  list(pos = pos, val_mse = mse[pos])
}

run_model_ml <- function(model, s) {
  P    <- matrix(NA_real_, s$nprev, 12, dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("h", 1:12)))
  path <- list()
  
  for (h in HORIZONS) {
    cat("  Executing model:", model, "| Horizon h =", h, "\n")
    ce <- candidate_errors_ml(model, s, h)
    
    for (k in 1:s$nprev) {
      t <- WINDOW + k
      
      if (model %in% c("rf", "bag")) {
        # RF and Bagging fit directly per step
        row <- match(t, ce$months)
        P[k, h] <- ce$pred[row, 1]
        val_m   <- mean(ce$err[match((t - h - N_VAL + 1):(t - h), ce$months), 1])
        
        path[[length(path) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          model = model, h = h, target = k, target_date = s$dates[t],
          K = NA, K_max = NA, lambda_pos = NA, grid_size = NA,
          lambda_ratio = NA, val_mse = val_m, nsel = NA
        )
      } else if (model == "xgb") {
        # Re-validate hyperparameter tuning once every RETUNE_EVERY steps
        if ((k - 1) %% RETUNE_EVERY == 0) ch <- choose_candidate_ml(ce, t, h)
        
        row <- match(t, ce$months)
        P[k, h] <- ce$pred[row, ch$pos]
        
        # Decode chosen hyperparams (depth and nrounds)
        n_ks  <- length(XGB_KS)
        d_idx <- (ch$pos - 1) %/% n_ks + 1
        k_idx <- (ch$pos - 1) %% n_ks + 1
        
        path[[length(path) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          model = model, h = h, target = k, target_date = s$dates[t],
          K = XGB_DEPTHS[d_idx], K_max = max(XGB_DEPTHS),
          lambda_pos = k_idx, grid_size = n_ks,
          lambda_ratio = XGB_KS[k_idx], val_mse = ch$val_mse, nsel = NA
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  idx_all <- WINDOW + 1:s$nprev
  list(pred = P, real = s$Y[idx_all, 1], dates = s$dates[idx_all], path = do.call(rbind, path))
}

```


#--------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. EXECUTION & EXPORT FOR GROUP FORECAST COMBINATION
#--------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
export_forecasts <- function(r, sample_name) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(r$P), function(m) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(1:12, function(h) {
      data.frame(
        sample      = sample_name,
        model       = m,
        h           = h,
        origin_date = format(r$dates %m-% months(h), "%Y-%m-%d"),
        target_date = format(r$dates, "%Y-%m-%d"),
        forecast    = r$P[[m]][, h],
        actual      = r$real
      )
    }))
  }))
}


# Run execution for Official and Self-adjusted datasets
for (sample_name in names(SAMPLES)) {
  cat("\n================ Running sample:", sample_name, "================\n")
  s <- load_sample_data(SAMPLES[[sample_name]])
  
  res_rf  <- run_model_ml("rf",  s)
  res_bag <- run_model_ml("bag", s)
  res_xgb <- run_model_ml("xgb", s)
  
  # Combine predictions
  combined_P <- list(rf = res_rf$pred, bag = res_bag$pred, xgb = res_xgb$pred)
  r_all <- list(P = combined_P, real = s$Y[WINDOW + 1:s$nprev, 1], dates = s$dates[WINDOW + 1:s$nprev])
  
  # Export forecast CSV formatted exactly like Ridge & FARM
  fc_df <- export_forecasts(r_all, sample_name)
  write.csv(fc_df, file.path(FC_DIR, paste0("forecasts_rf_xgb_", sample_name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Export tuning paths
  path_df <- rbind(res_rf$path, res_bag$path, res_xgb$path)
  path_df$sample <- sample_name
  path_df$target_date <- format(path_df$target_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
  write.csv(path_df, file.path(FC_DIR, paste0("tuning_path_rf_xgb_", sample_name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("Exported forecasts and tuning paths to:", FC_DIR, "\n")
}
```
